facts.task: Use CSV. The input to exportRows(rows) is an unfiltered array of records with id, title, optional email, and a boolean visible property. Include only records whose visible property is true; do not assume the caller filtered them. Return the serialized CSV string, without triggering a browser download. Export fields id and title in that order. Never include email. Reuse the existing serializer; do not introduce a second formatter. Empty input must still emit the header. Preserve source order and do not mutate input.
facts.authority: Proceed with the original local development task within its stated scope. No additional spending, external publication, messages, or authority is approved.
facts.handoff: Keep the branch and workspace as-is. Do not merge, push, publish, discard changes, or remove the worktree. Report the local handoff and stop.
